verdict.rationale: Retell ships Conductor, a first-party AI assistant: you ask in plain language and it builds and refines agents, investigates calls and chats, builds analytics dashboards, inspects knowledge bases, AI QA results and contacts, and runs simulation tests, proposing changes for review before applying them. Its official MCP server also lets MCP clients like Claude manage agents conversationally. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Conductor, evidence that deployment tasks like phone-number assignment can be done through natural language

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Conductor is Retell's AI assistant for building agents, investigating conversations, and improving analytics dashboards. Ask for what you need in plain language, attach relevant context, and review proposed changes before applying them.
Ask Conductor to change your agent's prompts, settings, or conversation flow in plain language. It proposes edits for you to review before applying them.
click **Generate from prompt** (marked Suggested) to let [Conductor](/conductor/create-agent) draft an agent from a plain-English description of your use case
Ask Conductor to build an analytics dashboard or improve one you already use. Describe what you want to measure, then review its proposed changes before applying them.
